questions.explanation: Different investments address different stages of the learning and skills pipeline.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: शिक्षालाई संरचनागत आर्थिक रूपान्तरणसँग जोड्ने सही दृष्टिकोण कुन हो?
options: शिक्षा–सीपलाई कृषि, उद्योग, सेवा, प्रविधि र उद्यमशीलताको मागसँग जोड्नु
questions.explanation: Human capital must evolve with the productive structure of the economy.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: सोह्रौँ योजना र वार्षिक बजेटको विकास पूर्वाधार दृष्टिले शिक्षामा सबैभन्दा परिणाममुखी संयोजन कुन हो?
options: access + learning quality + skills + digital inclusion + industry linkage
questions.explanation: Education infrastructure should ultimately improve human capital and labour-market outcomes.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्यलाई आर्थिक विकासको पूर्वाधार किन मानिन्छ?
options: स्वास्थ्य खर्चको कुनै आर्थिक प्रभाव नभएकाले
स्वस्थ मानव पूँजीले श्रम उत्पादकत्व र आर्थिक सहभागिता बढाउन सक्ने भएकाले
questions.explanation: Health affects human capital, productivity and household economic security.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य सेवाको भौतिक पहुँचमा कुन कुरा आधारभूत हुन्छ?
options: स्वास्थ्य संस्था, जनशक्ति, औषधि, उपकरण र यातायात पहुँच
questions.explanation: Health access depends on service availability and the ability to reach and use it.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य सुधारले productivity मा कसरी योगदान गर्न सक्छ?
options: रोगका कारण हुने अनुपस्थिति र कार्यक्षमता ह्रास घटाएर
questions.explanation: Better health improves effective labour supply and productivity.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य सेवा र कार्यको सही जोडी कुन हो?
options: प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य — रोकथाम, प्रारम्भिक उपचार र referral
questions.explanation: Primary care emphasizes prevention, early detection and appropriate referral.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य बजेटको परिणाममुखी मूल्याङ्कनमा कुन कुरा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ?
options: सेवा coverage, quality, financial protection र health outcomes
questions.explanation: Health spending should be assessed against service and outcome indicators.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य मानव पूँजीको आर्थिक प्रभाव कुन हो?
options: काम गर्ने क्षमता, सिकाइ र जीवनकालमा उत्पादकता सुधार
questions.explanation: Health is a component of human capital.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य वित्तीय सुरक्षा सम्बन्धी कुन कथन सही छ?
options: अत्यधिक out-of-pocket खर्चले घरपरिवारलाई गरिबीमा धकेल्न सक्छ
स्वास्थ्य खर्चको घरपरिवार आयसँग सम्बन्ध हुँदैन
questions.explanation: High medical costs can create financial hardship; risk pooling provides protection.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य बीमाको आर्थिक तर्क कुन हो?
options: व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जोखिमलाई pooling मार्फत वित्तीय जोखिममा रूपान्तरण गर्नु
questions.explanation: Insurance pools risks across people and time.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: पोषण सुधारको आर्थिक लाभ कुन हो?
options: बालबालिकाको शारीरिक/मानसिक विकास र भविष्यको productivity सुधार
questions.explanation: Early-life nutrition has long-term human capital effects.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: बाल स्वास्थ्य सुधारले शिक्षामा कुन प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ?
options: attendance, concentration र learning capacity सुधार्न सहयोग
questions.explanation: Health and nutrition are complementary inputs to learning.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य प्रणालीको गुणस्तरमा स्वास्थ्य जनशक्तिको भूमिका कुन हो?
options: उचित संख्या, सीप, वितरण र retention ले सेवा गुणस्तर प्रभावित गर्छ
questions.explanation: Health workforce is a core health-system input.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य पहुँच र समाधानको सही जोडी कुन हो?
options: दुर्गम क्षेत्र — outreach, referral transport र telemedicine
questions.explanation: Remote access needs outreach and referral mechanisms alongside facilities.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: रोकथाममुखी स्वास्थ्य नीतिको आर्थिक लाभ कुन हो?
options: रोगको incidence र उपचार लागत घटाउन सहयोग
questions.explanation: Prevention can reduce avoidable illness and future treatment costs.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य तथ्याङ्कको राम्रो उपयोग कुन हो?
options: रोगको प्रवृत्ति, सेवा coverage र स्रोत विनियोजनका लागि evidence तयार गर्नु
questions.explanation: Health information systems support planning, surveillance and resource allocation.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विपद् प्रतिरोधी स्वास्थ्य पूर्वाधारमा कुन कुरा आवश्यक हुन्छ?
options: सुरक्षित भवन, emergency stock, backup power र referral plan
questions.explanation: Resilience requires infrastructure and operational continuity.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: Digital health को उचित प्रयोग कुन हो?
options: कागजी record पूर्ण रूपमा नष्ट गरेर backup नराख्नु
electronic records, telemedicine, appointment र health information management सुधार
questions.explanation: Digital health improves coordination but needs privacy and security safeguards.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य सुधारले श्रम बजारमा कुन प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ?
options: काम गर्न सक्ने दिन र effective labour supply बढाउन
questions.explanation: Good health supports labour participation and productivity.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य सेवाको गुणस्तर सुधारमा कुन तत्व महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ?
options: clinical standards, trained staff, essential medicines, diagnostics र patient safety
questions.explanation: Quality is multidimensional and requires systems and inputs.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्यमा सार्वजनिक लगानीले गरिबी न्यूनीकरणमा कसरी योगदान गर्न सक्छ?
options: रोगजन्य खर्च र काम गुम्ने जोखिम घटाउँदै household economic security बढाउन
questions.explanation: Health shocks can cause income loss and catastrophic expenditure.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य पूर्वाधार र WASH को सही जोडी कुन हो?
questions.explanation: WASH is a key determinant of population health.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य बजेट बढे पनि दुर्गम क्षेत्रमा सेवा coverage कम छ भने कुन पक्ष हेर्नुपर्छ?
options: भौगोलिक वितरण, स्वास्थ्य जनशक्ति, supply chain, referral र outreach
questions.explanation: Aggregate spending can hide distribution and implementation bottlenecks.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य referral system मा यातायात किन महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ?
options: गम्भीर बिरामीलाई समयमै higher-level care मा पुर्‍याउन
questions.explanation: Timely referral can be critical for emergency and specialized care.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य प्रविधिमा लगानीको प्राथमिक मूल्याङ्कन कसरी गर्नुपर्छ?
options: clinical benefit, cost-effectiveness, access र sustainability हेरेर
questions.explanation: Technology investment should consider value and system capacity, not purchase price alone.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: संघीय स्वास्थ्य प्रणालीमा कुन कुरा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ?
options: तहगत जिम्मेवारी, referral network, standards र वित्तीय समन्वय
questions.explanation: Health systems need coordinated service networks across levels.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: मातृ तथा बाल स्वास्थ्यमा लगानीको दीर्घकालीन आर्थिक महत्त्व कुन हो?
options: मानव पूँजी, survival र भविष्यको productivity सुधार
questions.explanation: Early-life health has long-term human-capital effects.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य supply chain को सही जोडी कुन हो?
options: औषधि logistics — आवश्यक औषधिको निरन्तर उपलब्धता सुनिश्चित गर्नु
questions.explanation: Supply chain performance directly affects availability of medicines and vaccines.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: दिगो स्वास्थ्य प्रणालीको प्रमुख विशेषता कुन हो?
options: गुणस्तरीय सेवा, वित्तीय दिगोपन, resilient infrastructure र skilled workforce
questions.explanation: Sustainability requires service quality and system capacity over time.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: उच्च उपचार खर्च तर कमजोर प्राथमिक रोकथाम भएको क्षेत्रमा कुन बजेट पुनर्सन्तुलन तार्किक हुन्छ?
options: प्राथमिक रोकथाम, early detection र cost-effective interventions बलियो बनाउने
questions.explanation: Prevention and early intervention can reduce avoidable downstream costs.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्यलाई संरचनागत आर्थिक विकाससँग जोड्ने दृष्टिकोण कुन हो?
options: स्वास्थ्य, पोषण, शिक्षा, पानी, सरसफाइ र उत्पादक रोजगारीलाई मानव पूँजी चक्रमा जोड्नु
questions.explanation: Human development inputs reinforce each other across the life cycle.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: सोह्रौँ योजना र बजेटको विकास पूर्वाधार दृष्टिले स्वास्थ्यमा उच्च प्रभाव पार्ने संयोजन कुन हो?
options: access + quality + prevention + financial protection + digital/resilient systems
questions.explanation: A resilient health system needs service, prevention, financing and infrastructure together.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् पूर्वाधारलाई आर्थिक विकासको आधार किन मानिन्छ?
options: उद्योग, कृषि, सेवा, घरपरिवार र डिजिटल अर्थतन्त्रको उत्पादन क्षमता बढाउने भएकाले
questions.explanation: Reliable electricity is a cross-sector productive infrastructure.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: नेपालको विद्युत् विकासमा जलविद्युत्को प्रमुख महत्त्व कुन हो?
options: देशको प्रमुख घरेलु ऊर्जा स्रोतका रूपमा उत्पादन र निर्यात सम्भावना
questions.explanation: Nepal has substantial hydropower potential and electricity can support domestic use and exports.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् पहुँच बढ्नुको आर्थिक प्रभाव कुन हो?
options: घरेलु जीवनस्तरसँगै उत्पादनमूलक गतिविधि र सेवा पहुँच विस्तार हुन सक्छ
digital economy मा कुनै प्रभाव हुँदैन
questions.explanation: Electricity access supports productive and social services.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा पूर्वाधार र आर्थिक परिणामको सही जोडी कुन हो?
options: भरपर्दो विद्युत् — उद्योगको downtime र उत्पादन लागत घटाउन सहयोग
questions.explanation: Reliable power is important for industrial operations.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा मिश्रण विविधीकरणको प्रमुख उद्देश्य कुन हो?
options: आपूर्ति जोखिम र एकै स्रोतमा निर्भरता घटाउनु
questions.explanation: A diversified energy mix can improve resilience.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: उत्पादन क्षमता बढे पनि transmission कमजोर भएमा मुख्य समस्या के हुन सक्छ?
options: उत्पादित विद्युत् माग केन्द्रसम्म पुर्‍याउन bottleneck सिर्जना हुनु
questions.explanation: Generation and transmission capacity must grow together.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् वितरण प्रणालीबारे कुन कथन सही छ?
options: कम loss, भरपर्दो supply र voltage quality ले उपभोक्ता र उद्योग दुवैलाई लाभ दिन्छ
questions.explanation: Distribution quality determines reliability and efficiency at the user end.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् र कृषि विकासको सही सम्बन्ध कुन हो?
options: विद्युतीकरण — सिँचाइ पम्प, cold storage र agro-processing सहज बनाउने
questions.explanation: Electricity supports irrigation, storage and processing in agriculture.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: डिजिटल अर्थतन्त्रका लागि विद्युत् किन आधारभूत हुन्छ?
options: data networks, devices, data centers र digital services सञ्चालनका लागि
digital service बिना पनि समान रूपमा चल्ने भएकाले
questions.explanation: Digital infrastructure ultimately depends on reliable power.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् पहुँच विस्तारले रोजगारीमा कुन प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ?
options: उत्पादनमूलक उद्यम र service activities का लागि operating conditions सुधार्न सक्छ
questions.explanation: Reliable electricity can enable enterprises to operate longer and more efficiently.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा दक्षताको आर्थिक लाभ कुन हो?
options: प्रति एकाइ उत्पादन ऊर्जा लागत र स्रोत खपत घटाउनु
questions.explanation: Energy efficiency reduces energy intensity.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: नवीकरणीय ऊर्जाको दीर्घकालीन लाभ कुन हो?
options: ऊर्जा सुरक्षा र कम-कार्बन विकासमा योगदान
questions.explanation: Renewables can diversify energy supply and support low-carbon development.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् बजार विस्तारमा कुन कुरा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ?
options: विश्वसनीय supply, demand growth, transmission capacity र उचित market arrangements
questions.explanation: Power market development needs both supply and network capacity.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: उद्योगको energy competitiveness सुधार्न कुन उपाय बढी प्रभावकारी हुन्छ?
options: भरपर्दो supply, उचित tariff, energy efficiency र grid quality सुधार
questions.explanation: Industrial energy competitiveness depends on price and quality of supply.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् उत्पादन बढे पनि औद्योगिक demand कम छ भने कुन पक्षको समीक्षा गर्नुपर्छ?
options: industrial competitiveness, tariff, reliability, connection cost र productive demand
questions.explanation: Supply expansion must be matched with productive demand and competitive conditions.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: जलविद्युत् आयोजना विकासमा transmission line किन आवश्यक हुन्छ?
options: उत्पादित ऊर्जा demand centres/market सम्म पुर्‍याउन
questions.explanation: Transmission connects generation sites to consumers and markets.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् निर्यातको दीर्घकालीन सम्भावना मूल्याङ्कन गर्दा कुन कुरा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ?
options: घरेलु surplus, उत्पादन लागत, transmission interconnection र regional demand
questions.explanation: Export viability depends on surplus and cross-border transmission/market conditions.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा क्षेत्रको decarbonization मा जलविद्युत्को भूमिका कसरी बुझिन्छ?
options: कम-कार्बन विद्युत् आपूर्ति बढाई जीवाश्म इन्धनमा निर्भरता घटाउन सहयोग गर्न सक्छ
questions.explanation: Hydropower is generally low-carbon in operation but projects still require environmental and social safeguards.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा पहुँचमा समावेशिता भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
options: दुर्गम तथा कमजोर आय समूहलाई पनि भरपर्दो र वहनयोग्य ऊर्जा पहुँच दिलाउनु
questions.explanation: Energy inclusion concerns availability, affordability and reliability.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् र सामाजिक पूर्वाधारको सही जोडी कुन हो?
options: सूचना तथा सञ्चार प्रविधि (Information and Communication Technology—ICT) — विद्युत् बिना समान रूपमा चल्ने
विद्यालय विद्युतीकरण — lighting, सूचना तथा सञ्चार प्रविधि (Information and Communication Technology—ICT) र learning environment सुधार
questions.explanation: Electricity supports lighting, ICT and equipment in education.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: स्वास्थ्य संस्थामा भरपर्दो विद्युत् किन आवश्यक हुन्छ?
options: diagnostics, refrigeration, surgery, lighting र digital systems सञ्चालनका लागि
questions.explanation: Health facilities depend on reliable power for essential equipment and services.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: कृषि मूल्य शृंखला विकासमा विद्युत्को भूमिका कुन हो?
options: irrigation, milling, drying, cold storage र processing सम्भव बनाउनु
questions.explanation: Electricity enables multiple post-harvest and processing activities.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा क्षेत्रको प्रगति मूल्याङ्कनमा कुन सूचक समूह बढी उपयुक्त हुन्छ?
options: generation, access, reliability, losses, consumption र transmission capacity
questions.explanation: Installed capacity alone does not measure service quality or access.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ठूला विद्युत् आयोजना बारम्बार ढिला हुँदा कुन पक्षको समीक्षा आवश्यक हुन्छ?
options: survey/design, financing, procurement, land, transmission coordination र project governance
questions.explanation: Energy projects face multiple implementation risks beyond financing.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: भरपर्दो विद्युत् आपूर्तिले निजी लगानीलाई किन आकर्षित गर्न सक्छ?
options: उत्पादन जोखिम र operating uncertainty घटाउन
questions.explanation: Power reliability is an important operating condition for firms.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा resilience र उपायको सही जोडी कुन हो?
options: grid redundancy — outage को प्रभाव घटाउन सहयोग
questions.explanation: Redundancy, maintenance and diversification improve system resilience.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: ऊर्जा बजेटलाई उत्पादनमूलक बनाउन कुन संयोजन महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ?
options: generation + transmission + distribution + maintenance + productive demand
questions.explanation: Energy investment must address the full value chain.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: विद्युत् surplus लाई आर्थिक विकासमा रूपान्तरण गर्न कुन नीति बढी प्रभावकारी हुन्छ?
options: उद्योग, agro-processing, electric mobility र digital services मा productive electricity use बढाउनु
questions.explanation: Surplus power creates value when used in productive activities or viable export markets.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: सोह्रौँ योजनाको पूर्वाधार तथा उत्पादकत्व दृष्टिकोणसँग विद्युत् क्षेत्रको कुन रणनीति बढी मेल खान्छ?
options: भरपर्दो पहुँच, grid expansion, productive use र energy efficiency सँग उत्पादन वृद्धि जोड्नु
questions.explanation: Infrastructure should translate into productive capacity and productivity gains.

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास
questions.q: सोह्रौँ योजना, आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण र बजेटलाई समेटेर ऊर्जा पूर्वाधारको दीर्घकालीन प्राथमिकता कुन हो?
options: access + reliability + transmission + productive demand + export readiness + resilience
questions.explanation: A mature power sector needs generation, networks, demand, markets and resilience together.

दिगो विकास लक्ष्यहरू (Sustainable Development Goals—SDGs) को कार्यान्वयन

options: खाद्यान्न, खानेपानी, आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा र यातायात

questions.question: आर्थिक वृद्धिको तुलनामा आर्थिक विकासको दायरा व्यापक हुनुको मुख्य कारण के हो?

options: उत्पादन र प्रतिस्पर्धी निर्यात क्षमता बढाउनु

options: विदेशमा काम गर्ने व्यक्तिले स्वदेश पठाएको आय

questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Each row and column increases by one; the missing value is 5.

questions.question: Which statement is represented by the diagram?
options: ● is in A but not B
● is in B but not A
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The ● lies inside A and outside the overlapping B region.

questions.question: Where is ● located?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. The dot lies inside B, which is inside A; therefore it belongs to both.

questions.question: Which is the water image of the figure?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Water reflection reverses the figure vertically, including ▲ to ▼.

questions.question: A mirror is placed on the right. Which option shows the mirror image?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Right-side mirroring reverses the order and horizontal direction.

questions.question: Which option is definitely embedded in the figure?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The triangle △ appears as a complete embedded figure.

questions.question: Which simple figure is embedded?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The inner outline is a square.

questions.question: The dot moves 90° clockwise around the boundary. Where will it be?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. A 90° clockwise move from the top reaches the right.

questions.question: The dot is reflected across the horizontal middle line. Which position results?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. Horizontal reflection changes upper-left to lower-left.

questions.question: How many triangles are present as separate symbols?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. There are eight triangles surrounding the central square.

questions.question: How many small triangles are shown?
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D — चित्रमा जम्मा ४ वटा साना त्रिभुज छन्।

questions.question: Joining the two equal squares side by side forms which figure?
options: A rectangle twice as wide as high
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Two equal squares side by side form a rectangle with a 2:1 width-to-height ratio.

questions.question: Three equal triangles are joined edge-to-edge to form a larger outline. Which basic polygon is the intended outer shape?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The three triangles form a larger triangular outline.

questions.question: If the columns are transposed left-to-right, which arrangement results?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. Transposing rows and columns gives a 3×2 matrix: 1 4 / 2 5 / 3 6.

questions.question: If the two rows exchange positions, which arrangement is correct?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The two rows simply exchange positions.

questions.question: Which group completes the sequence?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The count increases every two steps while fill alternates; next is ●●●.

questions.question: Which comes next?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Each direction appears twice before rotating 90° clockwise; after ↓↓ comes ←.

questions.question: Select the next group.
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The shape alternates hollow/filled while the count increases; next is three filled diamonds.

questions.question: What is the next figure?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The two corner shapes alternate.

questions.question: Which symbol continues the rotation of the shaded semicircle?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The shaded semicircle rotates through four states and repeats.

questions.question: How many lines of symmetry does this figure have?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The plus-shaped arrangement has vertical and horizontal symmetry.

questions.question: Which figure is the odd one out based on shape boundary?
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. The first three have circular boundaries; □ is a quadrilateral.

questions.question: Which option is the water image of the arrow inside the box?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Water reflection reverses the vertical order: the dot is above the downward arrow.

questions.question: Which option is the right-side mirror image?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The order reverses and the arrow direction becomes left.

questions.question: If four separate triangles are joined only at their vertices, how many triangular figures remain?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. Each original triangle remains a separate triangular figure, so there are four.

questions.question: What is the missing symbol?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The checkerboard pattern requires ○ in the final cell.

questions.question: Choose the next figure.
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. The three-shape cycle repeats: ○, △, □.

questions.question: Find the next number: 2, 5, 8, 11, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The common difference is 3.

questions.question: Find the next number: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Each term is multiplied by 2.

questions.question: Find the missing number: 4, 9, 16, 25, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. These are consecutive squares: 2², 3², 4², 5², 6².

questions.question: Find the next number: 81, 27, 9, 3, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Each term is divided by 3.

questions.question: If 18 + 6 × 3 = ?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Multiplication is performed before addition: 18 + 18 = 36.

questions.question: What is 25% of 240?
What is 3/4 + 1/8?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. 3/4 = 6/8, so the sum is 7/8.

questions.question: 0.75 is equal to:
The ratio 18:24 in simplest form is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Divide both terms by 6.

questions.question: The average of 12, 18 and 24 is:
An article costs Rs. 500 and is sold for Rs. 600. The profit percentage is:
A number increased from 80 to 100. The percentage increase is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Increase 20 on base 80 gives 25%.

questions.question: A can complete a job in 10 days. What fraction of the job does A complete in one day?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. One-day work is 1/10.

questions.question: A car travels 150 km in 3 hours. Its average speed is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Speed = distance/time = 150/3 = 50 km/h.

questions.question: Simple interest on Rs. 2,000 at 5% per annum for 2 years is:
If today is Monday, what day will it be after 10 days?
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Ten days is one week plus three days: Thursday.

questions.question: If A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 4:5, then A:C is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Make B common: A:B=8:12 and B:C=12:15, so A:C=8:15.

questions.question: What is the least positive number divisible by both 12 and 18?
What is the greatest common divisor of 48 and 60?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. The greatest common divisor is 12.

questions.question: If 40% of a number is 72, the number is:
The average of five numbers is 18. Their sum is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Sum = average × count = 18×5 = 90.

questions.question: An item marked Rs. 800 is sold at a discount of 10%. Its selling price is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. 10% of 800 is 80, so selling price is 720.

questions.question: A and B together complete a job in 6 days. If their combined one-day work is equal, what fraction is completed per day?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. One-day combined work is 1/6.

questions.question: A 120 m train passes a pole in 6 seconds. Its speed is:
Which is the largest?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. 2/3 is approximately 0.667, larger than the others.

questions.question: 2.5 × 0.4 equals:
A sum of Rs. 700 is divided in the ratio 3:4. The larger share is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. The larger share is 4/7 × 700 = 400.

questions.question: After a 20% discount, an article costs Rs. 640. Its marked price was:
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. 640 is 80% of the marked price, so marked price = 800.

questions.question: What is 15² − 10²?
If x/5 = 12, what is x?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Multiply both sides by 5.

questions.question: Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. Terms are n(n+1): 1×2, 2×3, ...; next is 6×7 = 42.

questions.question: Find the missing number: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Each term is previous term ×2 +1.

questions.question: Find the next number: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. These are consecutive squares; next is 6² = 36.

questions.question: Find the next number: 64, 32, 16, 8, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Each term is divided by 2.

questions.question: If 3x + 7 = 25, x equals:
The value of (18² − 12²) is:
A salary is increased by 15% and then decreased by 10%. The net percentage change is:
An article is bought for Rs. 1,200 and sold for Rs. 1,380. Profit percentage is:
An article is sold for Rs. 900 at a 10% loss. Its cost price is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. 900 is 90% of cost price, so CP = 1,000.

questions.question: The simple interest on Rs. 5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years is:
The compound amount on Rs. 10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually, is:
If A:B = 5:7 and A+B = 144, then B equals:
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. 12 parts = 144, so one part = 12 and B = 84.

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 2:3:5 and their sum is 200. The largest is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. 10 parts = 200, so 5 parts = 100.

questions.question: The average of 8 numbers is 24. If one number 38 is removed, the average of the remaining seven is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Total 192; remaining total 154; 154/7 = 22.

questions.question: A can do a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, they complete it in:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Combined rate = 1/12+1/18=5/36, so time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.question: A completes a task in 15 days and B in 10 days. If they work together for 3 days, what fraction remains?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Combined rate = 1/6; in 3 days they do 1/2, so 1/2 remains.

questions.question: A person walks at 6 km/h. How long will it take to cover 15 km?
A train travels 360 km at 72 km/h. The travel time is:
A man increases his speed from 40 km/h to 50 km/h. For the same distance, the time is reduced by:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Time is inversely proportional to speed: 1−40/50 = 20%.

questions.question: A 20 L mixture contains milk and water in ratio 3:1. How much water is present?
A solution contains acid and water in ratio 2:3. If total solution is 25 L, acid is:
If 1 January is Wednesday in a non-leap year, what day is 1 February?
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. January has 31 days, so the day advances by 3: Wednesday to Saturday.

questions.question: Is x greater than 10? Statement I: x = 12. Statement II: x is an even number.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Statement I directly establishes x = 12.

questions.question: A shop sold 120, 150, 180 and 210 units in four successive months. What was the average monthly sale?
A class has 40 students. 60% are female. How many are male?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. Female = 24, so male = 16.

questions.question: A company's sales rise from 800 units to 1,000 units. The increase is what percentage of the original sales?
If 2x + 3y = 18 and x = 3, then y is:
The area of a rectangle of length 15 cm and breadth 8 cm is:
The perimeter of a square is 48 cm. Its area is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. Side = 48/4 = 12; area = 144 cm².

questions.question: A fair die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting an even number?
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Even outcomes are 2, 4, 6: 3 out of 6 = 1/2.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: All auditors are analysts. Some analysts are planners. Conclusions: I. Some auditors are planners. II. All auditors are analysts.
questions.solution: Conclusion II directly restates the first statement. Conclusion I does not necessarily follow because the analysts who are planners need not be auditors.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: No inspectors are clerks. Some clerks are accountants. Conclusions: I. Some accountants are not inspectors. II. No accountant is an inspector.
questions.solution: The clerks who are accountants cannot be inspectors, so some accountants are not inspectors. Nothing establishes that every accountant is a clerk.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: All permits are documents. No document is confidential. Conclusions: I. No permit is confidential. II. Some documents are permits.
questions.solution: Every permit is a document and no document is confidential, so no permit is confidential. Existence of permits is not stated.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: Some researchers are writers. All writers are readers. Conclusions: I. Some researchers are readers. II. All readers are writers.
questions.solution: The researchers who are writers are necessarily readers. The reverse relationship is not given.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The municipality introduced an online permit system, and the average processing time fell substantially within three months. Conclusions: I. The online system may have contributed to faster processing. II. Every municipality should immediately adopt the same system.
questions.solution: The observed association supports a cautious possible inference, but it does not prove that every municipality should immediately adopt the same system.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: A survey found that employees who received regular feedback reported higher job satisfaction than those who did not. Conclusions: I. Regular feedback is the only cause of job satisfaction. II. Regular feedback is associated with higher reported satisfaction.
questions.solution: The survey establishes an association, not a sole causal explanation.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The library extended its opening hours during examination month after students requested longer access. Conclusions: I. Students value access to the library. II. All students requested the extension.
questions.solution: The request and response support the first conclusion. The statement does not say all students made the request.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: A road was closed for maintenance for seven days, during which traffic was diverted to an alternative route. Conclusions: I. The original road required maintenance. II. The alternative route was shorter.
questions.solution: The closure for maintenance directly supports I. No comparison of route lengths is given.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The office should publish a plain-language guide to its new application procedure. Assumptions: I. Applicants may have difficulty understanding the current procedure. II. A clearer guide could help applicants follow the procedure.
options: Both I and II are implicit
questions.solution: The recommendation presumes both a communication difficulty and that clearer guidance can address it.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The department should add more public-service counters on peak days to reduce queues. Assumptions: I. Peak-day demand can create long queues. II. Additional counters can help handle the demand.
questions.solution: Both assumptions are necessary for the recommendation to make sense.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The school should provide a digital copy of the timetable to parents. Assumptions: I. Parents may need convenient access to the timetable. II. Every parent owns a smartphone.
questions.solution: Convenient access is a reasonable implicit basis. Universal smartphone ownership is not required by the recommendation.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The agency should train frontline staff before launching the new service. Assumptions: I. Staff knowledge can affect service delivery. II. Training can improve staff readiness.
questions.solution: The proposal relies on both the relevance of staff competence and the usefulness of training.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Assertion (A): A department should keep a backup of important digital records. Reason (R): Digital records can become inaccessible because of hardware failure or other technical problems.
options: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
A is false, but R is true
questions.solution: Technical failure is a direct reason why backup copies are needed.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Assertion (A): A committee should record the reasons for major decisions. Reason (R): Recorded reasons can improve transparency and allow later review.
options: Both true, but R does not explain A
Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
questions.solution: The reason directly supports the practice of recording reasons.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A city experienced unusually heavy rainfall, followed by localized flooding in low-lying areas. Which is the most reasonable inference?
options: Heavy rainfall can be a contributing cause of localized flooding
Flooding always occurs whenever it rains
questions.solution: Heavy rainfall can exceed drainage capacity and contribute to flooding; the other options make unjustified absolute claims.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A factory installed preventive maintenance software, after which unplanned machine downtime decreased. Which conclusion is most justified?
options: The software is proven to be the only cause
The decrease may be related to improved maintenance planning
questions.solution: The timing suggests a possible contribution, but it does not establish exclusive causation.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A public office receives repeated complaints that citizens cannot easily find its service requirements online. Courses of action: I. Redesign the information page using clear headings and a checklist. II. Stop publishing service requirements online.
questions.solution: Improving clarity addresses the complaint; removing information would worsen access.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A school notices a sudden increase in absenteeism. Courses of action: I. Examine attendance records and consult students and families. II. Punish every absent student immediately without investigation.
questions.solution: Fact-finding is appropriate before deciding on interventions. Blanket punishment without understanding causes is not.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A water-supply office finds that one neighborhood has repeated leakage complaints. Courses of action: I. Inspect the relevant network and identify the source. II. Replace every pipe in the entire city immediately.
questions.solution: Targeted inspection is proportionate. Citywide replacement without diagnosis is excessive.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: An examination board discovers that a published notice contains an incorrect application deadline. Courses of action: I. Issue a corrected notice promptly through the same official channels. II. Leave the error uncorrected to avoid confusion.
questions.solution: Prompt correction reduces harm and ensures applicants receive accurate information.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five reports P, Q, R, S and T are arranged from first to last. P is before R. Q is after S. T is before P. Which report can be first?
questions.solution: T must be before P, and P before R; Q must be after S. Therefore T can be first.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Six tasks A, B, C, D, E and F are scheduled in six slots. A is immediately before B. C is before D. E is after B. Which pair must occupy consecutive slots?
questions.solution: The condition explicitly makes A immediately before B.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Four officers K, L, M and N have different ranks. K is senior to L. M is junior to N but senior to L. Who can be the most senior?
questions.solution: N is above M, and M is above L. K is above L but is not compared with N; therefore the statement set does not force N to be above K. Thus no option is necessarily most senior.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Seven files are processed in an order. File H is third. File J is immediately after K. File L is before K. Which file cannot be first?
questions.solution: H is fixed in the third position, so it cannot be first.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five people A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. B sits immediately to the right of A. C sits at the left end. E sits to the left of D. Which arrangement is possible?
questions.solution: In C-A-B-E-D, C is at the left end, B is immediately right of A, and E is left of D.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A three-member committee is selected from P, Q, R and S. If P is selected, Q must also be selected. If Q is selected, R cannot be selected. Which committee is valid?
questions.solution: P,Q,S satisfies P→Q and avoids Q with R. The other choices violate at least one condition.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A meeting must include exactly three of four topics A, B, C and D. A cannot be together with C. B must be included if D is included. Which set is possible?
questions.solution: A,B,D satisfies the A-C restriction and includes B whenever D is present.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: What is the value of x? Statement I: x is an even integer greater than 4 and less than 8. Statement II: x is divisible by 3.
questions.solution: Statement I alone is sufficient because the only even integer strictly between 4 and 8 is 6.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Three statements are made: A says, 'B is lying.' B says, 'C is lying.' C says, 'A and B are both lying.' If exactly one person is telling the truth, who is truthful?
questions.solution: If B is truthful, C is lying and A is also lying, giving exactly one truthful speaker.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A candidate is eligible if the candidate has either a degree and two years of experience, or a diploma and five years of experience. Which candidate is eligible?
questions.solution: The third candidate satisfies the first eligibility route exactly.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: All policy analysts are researchers. Some researchers are economists. No economist is an auditor. Conclusions: I. Some researchers are not auditors. II. Some policy analysts are not auditors.
questions.solution: The researchers who are economists are not auditors, so I follows. There is no stated existence of policy analysts among those researchers.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: All effective projects have measurable objectives. Some government projects are effective. No project with unclear objectives is measurable. Which conclusion must be true?
options: Some government projects have measurable objectives
No government project has unclear objectives
questions.solution: The effective government projects have measurable objectives by the first statement.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: Some managers are trainers. All trainers are communicators. No communicator is isolated from teams. Conclusions: I. Some managers are communicators. II. Some managers are not isolated from teams.
questions.solution: Managers who are trainers are communicators, and communicators are not isolated from teams. Both conclusions follow.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Every audited account is reviewed. Some reviewed accounts are corrected. No corrected account is pending approval. Which conclusion is necessarily true?
options: No audited account is pending approval
Some reviewed accounts are not pending approval
questions.solution: The accounts that are corrected are reviewed and, by the third statement, are not pending approval.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: A pilot program in three districts reduced average document-processing time by 18%, while staffing levels remained unchanged. Conclusions: I. The pilot may have improved process efficiency. II. The same 18% reduction will necessarily occur everywhere.
questions.solution: The observed result supports a possible efficiency improvement. It cannot guarantee an identical result elsewhere.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: An institution requires applicants to submit documents through a single verified portal rather than by email. Conclusions: I. The institution seeks a more controlled submission process. II. Email can never be secure.
questions.solution: A verified portal indicates a controlled submission objective. The absolute claim about all email security is unsupported.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The ministry should publish quarterly performance dashboards so citizens can track progress. Assumptions: I. Citizens may use performance information to monitor public work. II. Publishing comparable indicators can make progress easier to assess.
questions.solution: The recommendation relies on both the usefulness of information to citizens and the value of comparable indicators.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: Before expanding the scholarship program nationwide, the authority should evaluate the pilot. Assumptions: I. Pilot results can provide evidence relevant to expansion. II. The pilot and nationwide program must be identical in every respect.
questions.solution: Evaluation assumes pilot evidence can inform the decision. Identical conditions everywhere are not necessary.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Assertion (A): An organization should separate approval and payment authorization for major purchases. Reason (R): Separating key controls can reduce the risk that one person can complete an improper transaction without detection.
options: Both are true and R explains A
Both are true but R does not explain A
questions.solution: The reason directly explains the internal-control benefit of separation of duties.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A public transport operator changed routes without consulting traffic data. Afterward, congestion increased at several intersections. Which explanation is most logically plausible?
options: Traffic data can never predict congestion
The route change may have shifted traffic into already constrained intersections
The route change proves every intersection was affected
Congestion is unrelated to transport routes
questions.solution: A route change can redistribute traffic; the other statements are unsupported absolutes.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A hospital introduced an appointment-reminder system and observed fewer missed appointments. Which additional evidence would best strengthen a causal interpretation?
options: The hospital's total number of employees
Comparison with a similar period or group without the reminder system
The color of the reminder messages
questions.solution: A suitable comparison group or period helps distinguish the intervention effect from other changes.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A university reports that students attending a study-support program have higher pass rates. Which factor is most important before claiming the program caused the difference?
options: Whether the program had a logo
Whether the classrooms were painted recently
Whether the report used a short title
Whether participants already differed in motivation or prior performance
questions.solution: Pre-existing differences between participants and non-participants can confound the observed relationship.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: An agency's emergency procurement records show repeated missing justifications. Which course is most appropriate first?
options: Review the cases, identify the control failure, and require documented justification
Ignore the issue because emergencies are unpredictable
questions.solution: A targeted review can identify the weakness and lead to corrective controls without abandoning necessary emergency procurement.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A district must choose one of four projects. Project A has high impact but exceeds the budget. B has moderate impact and fits the budget. C has low impact and fits the budget. D has high impact but lacks a feasibility assessment. If budget compliance and feasibility are mandatory, which should be selected?
questions.solution: B satisfies the mandatory constraints and offers moderate impact; A exceeds budget and D lacks required feasibility assessment.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: An online service becomes unavailable for several hours during a deadline period. Which response is most appropriate?
options: Extend the deadline or provide an alternative channel while investigating the outage
Require applicants to keep trying without notice
questions.solution: A fair contingency protects applicants while the technical problem is investigated.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A supervisor must allocate limited training seats. Priority is given to staff whose roles are directly affected by a new system, then to staff who have not received training before. Which applicant should have highest priority?
options: Staff member unaffected and already trained
Staff member unaffected and never trained
Staff member affected but already trained
Staff member affected by the new system and never trained
questions.solution: The first applicant satisfies both the primary and secondary priority criteria.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five tasks A, B, C, D and E must be scheduled Monday to Friday, one per day. B must be after A. C must be immediately before D. E must be Friday. Which task must be Wednesday?
questions.solution: Since C-D must be consecutive and E is Friday, the pair must be Monday-Tuesday or Wednesday-Thursday. If Monday-Tuesday, A and B must occupy Wednesday-Thursday, so Wednesday could be A. Thus no listed task must be Wednesday.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Four interviews P, Q, R and S are scheduled in four slots. Q is before R. S is immediately after P. R is not last. Which sequence is valid?
questions.solution: Q-P-S-R satisfies Q before R, S immediately after P, and R is last—so it violates R not last. Therefore none? Check options: P-S-Q-R also has R last; P-Q-S-R has R last; S-P-Q-R has S not after P. Hence no sequence is valid.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A four-person panel is selected from A, B, C, D, E and F. A and B cannot serve together. C must serve if D serves. E cannot serve if F serves. Which panel is valid?
questions.solution: B,C,D,E satisfies A-B restriction; D is accompanied by C; E is not paired with F.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A project team needs exactly three skills: legal, financial and technical. Candidate pairs are: A has legal+financial; B has financial+technical; C has legal+technical; D has legal only. Which pair of candidates covers all three skills?
questions.solution: A supplies legal and financial, while B supplies financial and technical; together all three skills are covered.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability

questions.solution: The context indicates that “honest and frank” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: In “The policy may have unintended consequences,” what does “unintended” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “not planned or intended” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: In “The reform is likely to alleviate congestion,” what does “alleviate” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “reduce the severity of” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: In “The witness gave a coherent account,” what does “coherent” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “logical and consistent” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: In “The issue remains contentious,” what does “contentious” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “likely to cause disagreement” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: In “The data are inconclusive,” what does “inconclusive” mean?
options: not sufficient to prove a definite result
questions.solution: The context indicates that “not sufficient to prove a definite result” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: In “The organization faces a formidable challenge,” what does “formidable” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “difficult and demanding” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: In “The article offers a nuanced view,” what does “nuanced” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “showing subtle distinctions” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: A person who speaks many languages is called a
A government by officials or administrators is called
A statement that contradicts itself is a
A person who deliberately avoids society is a
A speech delivered without preparation is
A place where aircraft are kept and maintained is a
A person who studies the origin and development of words is an
A government ruled by a small group of powerful people is an
A person who cannot read or write is
A period of ten years is a
A person who strongly opposes a particular policy is a
A medicine or treatment used to prevent disease is
Choose the word closest in meaning to “prudent”.
questions.solution: “cautious” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “abundant”.
questions.solution: “plentiful” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “mitigate”.
questions.solution: “lessen” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “obsolete”.
questions.solution: “outdated” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “explicit”.
questions.solution: “clear” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “rigorous”.
questions.solution: “thorough” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “feasible”.
questions.solution: “practicable” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “resilient”.
questions.solution: “able to recover” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “scrutinize”.
questions.solution: “examine closely” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “substantial”.
questions.solution: “considerable” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “concise”.
questions.solution: “brief” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “impartial”.
questions.solution: “unbiased” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “transparent”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “scarce”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “rigid”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “expand”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “deliberate” (as an adjective meaning intentional).
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “hostile”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “permanent”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “inferior”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “mandatory”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “rational”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “inclusive”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “frequent”.
Choose the correct noun form of “accurate”.
questions.solution: “accuracy” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “economy” in “_____ growth”.
questions.solution: “economic” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun form of “resilient”.
questions.solution: “resilience” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “reason” in “a _____ decision”.
questions.solution: “reasonable” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun form of “efficient”.
questions.solution: “efficiency” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “benefit” in “a _____ arrangement”.
questions.solution: “beneficial” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun form of “demonstrate”.
questions.solution: “demonstration” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “rely” in “a _____ source”.
questions.solution: “reliable” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun form of “permit”.
questions.solution: “permission” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “industry” in “an _____ process”.
questions.solution: “industrial” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun form of “analyse”.
questions.solution: “analysis” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The _____ of the school addressed the assembly.
questions.solution: “principal” is the noun meaning the head of a school; “principle” means a rule or belief.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The committee's decision was based on professional _____.
questions.solution: “advice” is the noun meaning guidance; “advise” is the corresponding verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Please place the documents in the _____ cabinet, not the filing cabinet.
questions.solution: “stationery” means writing materials; “stationary” means not moving.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The new lighting will _____ the modern design of the hall.
questions.solution: “complement” means to complete or enhance something; “compliment” means praise.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The lawyer offered legal _____ to the client.
questions.solution: “counsel” means legal advice; “council” refers to a deliberative or governing body.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The researcher must _____ the original source in the article.
questions.solution: “cite” is the verb meaning to refer to a source as evidence or authority.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The training _____ covers ethics and public accountability.
questions.solution: “course” is the correct noun for a programme of study; “coarse” means rough.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: A short introduction will _____ the main lecture.
questions.solution: “precede” means to come before; “proceed” means to continue or move forward.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: I am not sure _____ the revised rule applies to this case.
questions.solution: “whether” is used to introduce an alternative or uncertainty; “weather” refers to atmospheric conditions.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The authority may _____ the application fee in exceptional cases.
questions.solution: “waive” means to give up or refrain from enforcing a requirement; “wave” refers to a gesture or moving swell.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The instructions were read _____ so that everyone could hear them.
Neither the manager nor the assistants ___ available today.
questions.solution: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject; assistants is plural, so are is correct.

questions.question: The quality of these products ___ improved considerably.
questions.solution: The subject quality is singular, so has is correct.

questions.question: A number of applicants ___ requested additional information.
questions.solution: A number of means several, so it takes a plural verb.

questions.question: Each of the proposals ___ carefully examined before approval.
questions.solution: Each is singular and therefore takes was.

questions.question: Ten kilometres ___ a long distance to walk in the heat.
questions.solution: A distance treated as one unit takes a singular verb.

questions.question: The committee, together with its chairperson, ___ meeting tomorrow.
questions.solution: The main subject committee is singular; together with does not change the number.

questions.question: By the time the guests arrived, we ___ dinner.
questions.solution: The earlier completed action takes the past perfect.

questions.question: She ___ in Kathmandu since 2022.
questions.solution: Since a point in the past with continuing relevance normally takes the present perfect.

questions.question: When I reached the office, the meeting ___.
questions.solution: The meeting started before I reached the office, so past perfect is appropriate.

questions.question: This time next month, they ___ the new bridge.
questions.solution: A completed action expected before a future point takes the future perfect.

questions.question: The new policy aims to reduce costs, improve service and ___.
questions.solution: The three coordinated verbs should be parallel: reduce, improve, increase.

questions.question: The officer is responsible for planning, budgeting and ___.
questions.solution: The preposition for is followed by parallel gerunds: planning, budgeting, supervising.

questions.question: The report is concise, accurate and ___.
questions.solution: Adjectival coordination requires a parallel adjective phrase.

questions.question: The programme seeks not only to train staff but also ___ systems.
questions.solution: Not only to train...but also to improve is parallel.

questions.question: I will call you when the meeting ___.
questions.solution: A future time clause introduced by when normally uses the present simple.

questions.question: The proposal, which was submitted yesterday, ___ several revisions.
questions.solution: The subject proposal is singular, so requires is correct.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Although he was tired, but he continued working.
Although tired, but he continued working.
Although he was tired, he continued working.
Although he tired, but continued working.
questions.solution: Although already introduces the contrast, so but is unnecessary.

questions.question: The reason ___ the project was delayed was lack of funding.
questions.solution: The standard construction is the reason why something happened.

questions.question: Choose the correctly placed modifier.
options: Walking to work, Maya was soaked by the rain.
Walking to work, the rain soaked Maya.
The rain, walking to work, soaked Maya.
Maya, the rain walking to work, was soaked.
questions.solution: Maya is the person walking to work, so the introductory modifier correctly refers to Maya.

questions.question: Choose the clearest sentence.
options: The officer reviewed the file carefully that contained errors.
The officer carefully reviewed the file that contained errors.
The officer reviewed carefully the file contained errors.
The officer the file reviewed carefully that contained errors.
questions.solution: The modifier carefully is naturally placed before the verb phrase, and the relative clause clearly modifies file.

questions.question: If I ___ more time, I would revise the report.
questions.solution: The second conditional uses past simple in the if-clause.

questions.question: If she had studied harder, she ___ the examination.
questions.solution: The third conditional uses would have plus past participle.

questions.question: Unless you ___ the form, your application cannot be processed.
questions.solution: Unless introduces a real condition, so present simple is used for the future meaning.

questions.question: Had the warning been issued earlier, the accident ___.
questions.solution: Had the warning... is an inverted third conditional, requiring might have been prevented.

questions.question: The committee decided to ___ the proposal until more evidence was available.
The new evidence ___ his earlier statement.
questions.solution: Bear out means confirm or support a statement.

questions.question: The manager asked the team to ___ the issue before making a decision.
The chairperson called ___ the meeting because several members were absent.
When the director arrived, the staff ___ for two hours.
questions.solution: An action continuing before another past event takes past perfect continuous.

questions.question: She said that she ___ the document the following day.
questions.solution: In reported speech, will normally shifts to would when the reporting verb is past.

questions.question: The teacher said, 'I am checking the papers.' Choose the correct reported form.
options: The teacher said that she was checking the papers.
The teacher said that I am checking the papers.
The teacher said that she is checking the papers tomorrow.
The teacher said that she had checked the papers.
questions.solution: Present continuous normally shifts to past continuous in reported speech.

questions.question: He said, 'I finished the work yesterday.' Choose the best reported form.
options: He said that he finished the work yesterday.
He said that he had finished the work the previous day.
He said that he has finished the work tomorrow.
He said that I had finished the work.
questions.solution: Past simple commonly shifts to past perfect and yesterday to the previous day.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The committee approved the plan.'
options: The plan is approved the committee.
The plan was approved by the committee.
The committee was approved by the plan.
questions.solution: The object becomes the passive subject: The plan was approved by the committee.

questions.question: Choose the active form: 'The report was prepared by the analyst.'
options: The analyst was preparing by the report.
The analyst has prepare the report.
questions.solution: The agent analyst becomes the active subject.

questions.question: Choose the best transformation: 'Despite being tired, she continued working.'
options: Although she was tired, she continued working.
Although she tired, but she continued working.
Because she was tired, she stopped working.
She continued working because she was tired.
questions.solution: Despite being tired can be expressed as Although she was tired.

questions.question: Choose the sentence closest in meaning: 'As soon as the bell rang, the students left.'
options: The students left long before the bell rang.
No sooner had the bell rung than the students left.
The students left although the bell never rang.
The students waited until after the bell rang.
questions.solution: No sooner had...than expresses an immediate sequence.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct in standard formal English?
options: Everyone has submitted his or her form.
questions.solution: Everyone is grammatically singular in traditional formal agreement.

questions.question: Choose the most formal sentence.
options: The data shows that the policy ain't working.
The data is showing the policy ain't effective.
The data indicates that the policy don't work.
The data indicate that the policy is ineffective.
questions.solution: The option uses formal vocabulary and standard agreement.

questions.question: The officer is responsible ___ preparing the report.
questions.solution: The standard collocation is responsible for.

questions.question: She is interested ___ public administration.
The decision was made ___ accordance with the law.
questions.solution: The fixed expression is in accordance with.

questions.question: The proposal is expensive; ___, it may produce substantial long-term savings.
questions.solution: However introduces a contrast between cost and long-term benefit.

questions.question: In the sentence 'The extremely careful officer checked the file,' the word 'extremely' is a
questions.solution: Extremely modifies the adjective careful, so it is an adverb.

questions.question: In 'The committee approved the proposal,' the word 'proposal' is a
questions.solution: Proposal names a thing and functions as the object of approved.

questions.question: In 'The revised policy was remarkably effective,' 'revised' functions as a
questions.solution: Revised modifies policy and functions adjectivally in the noun phrase.

questions.question: Neither the reports nor the final recommendation ___ convincing.
questions.solution: The nearer subject recommendation is singular, so is is correct.

questions.question: There ___ several reasons for the delay.
questions.solution: The real subject reasons is plural, so are is required.

questions.question: I ___ this book twice, but I still find it useful.
questions.solution: The present perfect describes an experience up to the present.

questions.question: By 2030, the agency ___ the digital system for several years.
questions.solution: An action continuing up to a future point takes future perfect continuous.

questions.question: The training focused on identifying risks, assessing impacts and ___ solutions.
questions.solution: The gerund sequence identifying, assessing, designing is parallel.

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'The officer ___ prepared the report received an award.'
questions.solution: Who refers to a person functioning as the subject of prepared.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The department ___ budget was reduced requested an explanation.'
questions.solution: Whose expresses possession: the department's budget.

questions.question: Choose the sentence without a dangling modifier.
options: After reviewing the file, the error became obvious.
After reviewing the file, the error was noticed.
After reviewing the file, the officer noticed the error.
After reviewing, the file showed the error.
questions.solution: The officer is the person who reviewed the file, so the modifier is correctly attached.

questions.question: If the data ___ more reliable, the conclusion would be stronger.
questions.solution: This hypothetical present condition uses were in the if-clause.

questions.question: The minister asked officials to ___ the matter urgently.
questions.solution: Deal with means handle or address.

questions.question: She said, 'I can complete it today.' Choose the best reported form.
options: She said that she can complete it today.
She said that she could complete it that day.
She said that I could complete it today.
She said that she had completed it that day.
questions.solution: Can shifts to could and today shifts to that day in standard reported speech.

questions.question: Choose the best transformation: 'It is believed that the policy will succeed.'
options: The policy is believed to succeed.
The policy is believing to succeed.
questions.solution: The impersonal passive can be transformed using subject plus be believed plus infinitive.

questions.question: The report consists ___ five sections.
questions.solution: The fixed construction is consists of.

questions.question: ___ the evidence was limited, the committee reached a cautious conclusion.
questions.solution: Although introduces a subordinate concessive clause.

questions.question: In 'They worked efficiently,' the word 'efficiently' is a
questions.solution: Efficiently modifies the verb worked, so it is an adverb.

questions.question: More than one employee ___ complained about the delay.
questions.solution: More than one normally takes a singular verb.

questions.question: She usually ___ to work by bus, but today she is walking.
questions.solution: The present simple describes a habitual action.

questions.question: The policy is intended to increase access, reduce inequality and ___ accountability.
questions.solution: The infinitive-like coordination uses increase, reduce, strengthen.

questions.question: If it rains tomorrow, the event ___ indoors.
questions.solution: The first conditional uses present simple in the if-clause and will in the main clause.

questions.question: Choose the best transformation: 'No other applicant was as qualified as Maya.'
options: Maya was less qualified than every applicant.
Every applicant was more qualified than Maya.
Maya was the most qualified applicant.
questions.solution: The superlative expresses the same comparison.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 10 a.m. ___ Monday.
questions.solution: At is used for clock time and on for a particular day.

questions.question: Choose the clearest sentence.
options: Using the new software, the officer completed the report quickly.
Using the new software, the report was completed quickly by the officer.
The report, using the new software, completed the officer quickly.
The officer completed using the new software the report quickly.
questions.solution: The officer is the user of the software, so the modifier correctly refers to the subject.

questions.question: In 'The proposal was approved unanimously,' the word 'unanimously' is a
questions.solution: Unanimously modifies the verb phrase was approved.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: What the committee needs are clearer rules.
What the committee needs is clearer rules.
What the committee needs is clearer guidance.
What the committee need are clearer guidance.
questions.solution: The subject What the committee needs is treated as singular, and clearer guidance is an appropriate singular/uncountable complement.

questions.question: The evidence was incomplete; ___, the committee postponed its decision.
questions.solution: Therefore expresses the result: because the evidence was incomplete, the decision was postponed.

questions.subject: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मामिला तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संघ/संस्था
questions.q: संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघ (UN) को औपचारिक रूपमा स्थापना कहिले भएको थियो?
questions.solution: संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघको स्थापना २४ अक्टोबर १९४५ मा भएको हो। स्थापनाकालमा पोल्याण्डसहित ५१ सदस्य राष्ट्र  थिए।

questions.subject: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मामिला तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संघ/संस्था
questions.q: दक्षिण एसियाली क्षेत्रीय सहयोग संगठन (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation—SAARC) को सचिवालय कहाँ रहेको छ?
questions.solution: SAARC को सचिवालय नेपालको काठमाडौंमा रहेको छ।

questions.subject: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मामिला तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संघ/संस्था
questions.q: बहुक्षेत्रीय प्राविधिक तथा आर्थिक सहयोगका लागि बंगालको खाडीको पहल (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation—BIMSTEC) मा हाल कति सदस्य राष्ट्र छन्?
questions.solution: BIMSTEC मा सात सदस्य राष्ट्र छन्।

questions.subject: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मामिला तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संघ/संस्था
questions.q: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ सुरक्षा परिषद्का स्थायी सदस्य राष्ट्रको संख्या कति हो?
questions.solution: सुरक्षा परिषद्का पाँच स्थायी सदस्य चीन, फ्रान्स, रुस, बेलायत र संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका हुन्।

questions.subject: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मामिला तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संघ/संस्था
questions.q: नेपालले संयुक्त राष्ट्रसङ्घको सदस्यता कहिले प्राप्त गरेको हो?
questions.explanation:
नेपाल सन् १९५५ डिसेम्बर १४ (२०१२ पुस २९) मा संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघको सदस्य राष्ट्र बनेको हो।
पहिलो स्थायी प्रतिनिधि: ऋषिकेश शाह (सन् १९५६–१९६०)
नेपाल सन् १९६९–१९७० र सन् १९८८–१९८९ मा दुई पटक संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघको सुरक्षा परिषद्को अस्थायी सदस्य भइसकेको छ।
 नेपाल सन् २०२४–२०२६ कार्यकालका लागि आर्थिक तथा सामाजिक परिषद (ECOSOC) को निर्वाचित भएको छ।

questions.subject: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मामिला तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संघ/संस्था
questions.q: नेपालको परराष्ट्र नीतिको आधारभूत प्राथमिकतामध्ये कुन संयोजन सबैभन्दा उपयुक्त छ?
options: सार्वभौमिकता, राष्ट्रिय हित, शान्ति र पारस्परिक सहयोग
questions.solution: नेपालको परराष्ट्र नीतिले सार्वभौमिकता, राष्ट्रिय हित, शान्ति, पारस्परिक सम्मान तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सहयोगलाई महत्त्व दिन्छ।

questions.subject: Non-verbal Reasoning
questions.q: दिइएको पूर्ण त्रिभुजलाई ४ वटा साना त्रिभुजमा विभाजन गरिएको छ। जम्मा कति त्रिभुज छन्?
questions.solution: ४ वटा साना त्रिभुज र बीचमा बनेको १ उल्टो त्रिभुज गरी जम्मा ५ त्रिभुज छन्।

questions.subject: Non-verbal Reasoning
questions.q: चित्रमा २ तहको त्रिभुज जालो छ। सबै आकार र दिशाका त्रिभुज गन्दा जम्मा कति हुन्छन्?
questions.solution: दुई तहको मानक त्रिभुज जालोमा ४ साना र १ ठूलो त्रिभुज गरी जम्मा ५ हुन्छन्।

questions.subject: Non-verbal Reasoning
questions.q: दिइएको ३ तहको समबाहु त्रिभुज जालोमा सबै सम्भावित त्रिभुज गन्दा संख्या कति हुन्छ?
questions.solution: ३ तहको मानक त्रिभुज जालोमा सबै आकार र दिशाका त्रिभुजको कुल संख्या १३ हुन्छ।

questions.subject: Non-verbal Reasoning
questions.q: ३ तहको त्रिभुज जालोमा साना त्रिभुज मात्र गन्दा कति हुन्छन्?
questions.solution: ३ तहको जालोमा सबैभन्दा साना त्रिभुज ९ वटा हुन्छन्।

questions.subject: Non-verbal Reasoning
questions.q: दिइएको ४ तहको मानक त्रिभुज जालोमा सबै आकारका त्रिभुज गन्दा जम्मा कति हुन्छन्?
questions.solution: ४ तहको मानक त्रिभुज जालोमा सबै आकार र दिशाका त्रिभुजको कुल संख्या २७ हुन्छ।

questions.subject: Non-verbal Reasoning
questions.q: चित्रको बाहिरी त्रिभुजलाई मध्यबिन्दुहरू जोडेर बनाइएको आकृतिमा कुल कति त्रिभुज छन्?
